'''IG-102''' was one of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]].

==Biography==
[[File:IG101GrievousIG102-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|IG-102 with Grievous.]]

IG-102, along with [[IG-101/Legends|IG-101]], served as the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General's bodyguards aboard [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Judging by his damaged photoreceptor, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] theorized that IG-102 had fought [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the past and come out ahead.<ref name="ROTSn" />

He and IG-101 personally led the force that successfully captured Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during their botched rescue attempt of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], as well as Skywalker's astromech droid, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. IG-102 casually shoved one of the battle droids aside, destroying it, before backing up the same droid's threat, though this time not as a preprogrammed security recording.<ref name="ROTSn" />

Bringing the Jedi before Grievous on the ''Invisible Hand''s bridge, they took up positions behind the General while the cyborg gloated over the Jedi. However, all on the bridge were distracted by a pyrotechnics display unleashed by Skywalker's astromech, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], allowing Kenobi to retrieve his lightsaber from the sheath pocket inside Grievous' cape, where it had been deposited as the newest addition to the cyborg's collection. Kenobi quickly cut his bonds and freed Skywalker, who wasted no time retrieving his own weapon.<ref name="ROTS" />

With the Jedi rearmed, Grievous ordered IG-102 and 101 to engage, and ''make them suffer''. The two droids initially teamed up on Kenobi, but IG-102 broke off to take Skywalker, leaving 101 to deal with Kenobi. Skywalker was able to fend off 102's initial assault, but despite his best efforts, was unable to mount a sufficient counter-attack, and was accordingly driven back.<ref name="ROTS" /> Unfortunately, the MagnaGuard grew careless, and paid for it.<ref name="ROTSn" /> Skywalker found an opening in 102's offense and cleaved the hapless droid in half at the hips.<ref name="ROTS" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:IG102destroyed-ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|IG-102 destroyed by Anakin Skywalker.]]</div>
The droid quickly fell to the ground with a muffled electronic scream, while Skywalker went on to free Palpatine from the remaining droids.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Characteristics==
===Abilities and skills===
IG-102 was trained in all seven forms of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by Grievous with coaching from Dooku, just like all other MagnaGuards. Executing his moves almost faster than the human eye could follow, IG-102 demonstrated a lack of hesitation and almost total commitment. However, again like all other MagnaGuards, 102 could be confused by unpredictability,<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> due to his own repetitive combat style, which proved to be his downfall, when he was cut in two by Skywalker.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Programming and traits===
Little is known about IG-102's personality, other than his basic programming that all MagnaGuard's received. He did, however, demonstrate a singular disregard - if not outright disdain - for other battle droids (which he considered inferior to his own superior composition), shown by his casual destruction of one.<ref name="ROTSn" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], Anakin cuts IG-102 at the knees. However, IG-102 continues to fight, balancing on his [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] while kicking Anakin with the remains of his thighs before being struck down.
